scope: Necessary post-prime nonzero support bound on original rejected v46 saved Mac350 outputs, after retaining the inapplicable zero-prime certificate. No threshold selection or inference.
method: Count target sources whose entire post-prime five-score sum is zero. Such sources cannot trigger at any positive threshold regardless of latch state. Independently compare prefix-sum and direct-window arithmetic on every saved output, retaining prime values, all tail windows and zero-source witnesses. Nonzero sources need not actually trigger; no threshold is proposed or evaluated.
limits: Reused correlated synthetic intention labels and original saved INT8 outputs only. This does not identify the training/quantization/platform cause of zero scores.
No population FAR/recall, new gate, model promotion, new/final data, physical latency/resources, board, playback or call-stability evidence.
The original zero-prime certificate remains inapplicable; no zero-confuser upper-bound claim is made by this different necessary support bound.
